## Parent

_TBD_ (DUX3-00)

## Problem

UNKNOWN is used as a universal container for missing telemetry, no selection, no samples, stale freshness, N/A, and backend errors — defeating triage.

## Scope

- [ ] Where existing series/frames already distinguish classes, map UI to typed labels:
  - `MISSING` / `TELEMETRY_ABSENT`
  - `STALE`
  - `NOT_STARTED`
  - `N/A` (applicability)
  - `VALID_EMPTY`
  - `BACKEND_ERROR`
  - retain `UNKNOWN` only when truly undetermined
- [ ] Apply across first-screen cells on all 7 boards (minimal title/description/mapping changes)
- [ ] Align with DUX3-03 contract
- [ ] Same-PR docs + tests where mappings exist

## Out of scope

- Inventing series solely to split UNKNOWN
- Formal WCAG token work (DUX3-31)

## Acceptance

- [ ] No first-screen bare UNKNOWN when typed class is already knowable from mappings
- [ ] operator-ux empty-state taxonomy updated
- [ ] Grafana tests green

## Depends on

- DUX3-03
- Prefer after DUX3-10…14 board P0s or in parallel with shared mapping helpers
